purpose: Conceptual project-card illustration; not a screenshot or a map of real orders
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 16:9 thumbnail illustration for a software project on a clean personal portfolio website. Create a polished, understated 3D globe with recognisable simplified continents and about twelve small colourful map pins distributed across it. The entire globe is visible, centred with comfortable margins, softly lit on a pale desaturated blue-grey background. Muted teal oceans, pale sage land, restrained purple and warm amber pins to suit an off-white and violet website theme. Crisp forms readable at a small card size. No text, numbers, labels, logos, interface, personal data or watermark. The image is conceptual artwork, not an application screenshot.
